resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register names the Idaho Panhandle National Forests; firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts both say Kaniksu National Forest. The elevation and county match, so these describe the same lookout. The story uses the register's name.
firelookout.com spells the 1932-1933 lookout Robert Sarf; the Idaho Fire Lookouts staff page spells it Saarf. The story uses Saarf from the staff page.

notes_for_editor: Medium confidence. Unresolved: (1) the Packsaddle Mountain page says a 76-foot Aermotor tower from 1934 was intended for Saddle Mountain, while the register and firelookout.com describe a 40-foot tower; the record's design is left as the register's 40-foot tower. (2) Staff dated 1932-1933 predate the 1935 build, so an earlier structure may have stood on the site; no source found describes one. (3) No source describes the cab's present condition or public access. The record's 'standing' status is not confirmed by a source on the cab itself; the only current-use statement is the communication-site note on Idaho Fire Lookouts. Nothing here supports climbing or entering the site.
